newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says American Eagle delisted.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says American Eagle delisted.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Monday that it would suspend trading in the common stock of American Eagle Group Inc, and that it would apply with the Security and Exchange Commission to delist the issues.

The exchange said it was suspending the stock because American Eagle had fallen below its continued listing criteria, adding that listed companies must have at least $8 million aggregate market value of publicly held shares and net tangible assets of at least $12 million available to common stock, among other requirements.
In addition, American Eagle announced that its principal subsidiary, American Eagle Insurance Co, had been placed in conservatorship with the Texas Department of Insurance, the exchange said.
